article_summaries.title: Free Realms Hits Eight Million User Milestone
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer repost of an SOE press release (posted February 8, 2010) saying Free Realms passed eight million unique registered users. It credits continued content development and names Player Housing, Live World Events and player parties as recent additions. It gives no quests, items or mechanics details.
